name: Dr. Marie Kelvin
source:
DOB: 23/01/2091
Occupation: Doctor/Assistant Cybernetics Technician/Researcher

Dr. Kelvin is one of Dr. Clark's assistants. She helps with operating the equipment used during Theo's maintenance along with her colleague and girlfriend Dr. Richards. In her time working on Theo's case she has become quite attached to him and often finds herself worrying about him after he leaves appointments.
